sloka: तस्याः स्तन अन्तरात् भ्रष्टो हारः तारा अधिप द्युतिः ।वैदेह्या निपतन् भाति गंगा इव गगनात् च्युता ॥३-५२-३३॥
transliteration: tasyāḥ stana antarāt bhraṣṭo hāraḥ tārā adhipa dyutiḥ ।vaidehyā nipatan bhāti gaṁgā iva gaganāt cyutā ॥3-52-33॥

translations.english: Sita's necklace shining like the bright Moon slipped from between her breasts like the river Ganga falling down from the sky.
